verdict.rationale: Asking what sign-in method a state filing portal publishes is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows bot walls: an Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials on robots.txt for nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. Nothing documents the sign-in path, whether it uses credential MFA, or whether it requires biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
